name: Jamie Davis (D-LA)
subject: I’m the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Both of my parents were raised on farms in Tensas Parish, Louisiana. My father by a sharecropper and my mother on a plantation.
They picked cotton by hand. For them it was survival and my grandparents did not believe that a formal education was necessary. For them missing school to go to work on the farm was the norm.
The only time my Dad could go to school was when the weather was so bad that nothing could be done on the farm. Kids would tease him saying, "Must be raining cause Stump (his nickname) is here and not at the farm."
The highest level of education my dad reached was the 8th grade but despite this, his informal education taught him to run a successful farm and he became the first in our family to own land.
My Dad gave me the opportunity to chart a different course and I was the first person in my family to graduate from high school and I went on to attend LSU.
Ultimately, Baton Rouge was too big a city with too much temptation for the farm boy from the country town of Waterproof and I returned home with my tail between my legs, sent back on academic probation with my first child on the way.
My father asked me sarcastically, "What are you going to do now Mr. Man?” And I told him earnestly, "I'm going to farm just like you do."
And that’s what I’ve been doing to this day. Starting off with the 220 acres that my Dad leased, we worked to grow the farm to where we stand today — farming 3,200 acres, 700 of which belong to my family.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Unfortunately, in my 55 years of life here in Louisiana much has changed for the worse. Life has been sucked out of our small towns by monopolies like Dollar General and Walmart. Agriculture has become far less profitable, dominated by big business, and I have watched all of my Dad’s friends that were black farmers go out of business.
Our beloved home is turning into something unrecognizable. Louisianans on both sides of the aisle recognize this and they are ready for radical change.
I have to take a stand and fight for the way of life that we had when I grew up here as a boy and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
Dems can win here statewide — look no further than our last Governor, Democrat John Bel Edwards. And now a blue wave is forming, putting Louisiana in play for Democrats like me who can articulate an authentic vision of FDR-style economic populism that can compete with and defeat the fake populism of MAGA.
Taking this seat means electing Louisiana's first black senator and statewide elected official since reconstruction. It means we reclaim the Senate with an unshakeable majority — the Trump administration goes down in flames when we pull this off. Winning Louisiana is now possible and it’s why I’m asking you to join us in this last stand with a donation of $25, $10, or even just $5 to help Democrats take this now within reach Senate seat. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
CHIP IN TO FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
We have the opportunity to pull off something historic in Louisiana that will do a whole lot of good for people here. I couldn’t be more grateful to have you fighting alongside me.
Jamie Davis
Democrat for U.S. Senate

This is a comprehensive strategic approach to fight back against the GOP redistricting crisis
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731249/625488906/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwMWZmM2VlLTcyNjAtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bSS8YofywDGCZYar9sJuEv_2ACrdsnPsh8gz45XWv0M=&emci=52052439-2860-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=701ff3ee-7260-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045)

Peter, As we write this, Democrats remain poised to take back the House of Representatives this fall. That simply would not be true if our movement didn’t fight back when Donald Trump unleashed an unprecedented attempt to gerrymander states across the country. If we had not rapidly mobilized, Congress would have been locked in Republican hands for the foreseeable future. But the bad news is now that the Supreme Court has gutted voting rights protections, we are entering a new stage of this crisis — one that is shamelessly rooted in insidious racial discrimination. **This poses an existential threat to American voters: denying the people the right to choose their government and enabling rampant corruption by limiting voters’ ability to hold politicians accountable. ** **The good news is we have a rigorous, multi-front strategy to defeat Trump’s gerrymandering and protect our democracy.** You can [**read all about the plan here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731250/625488907/-367685688?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwMWZmM2VlLTcyNjAtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bSS8YofywDGCZYar9sJuEv_2ACrdsnPsh8gz45XWv0M=&emci=52052439-2860-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=701ff3ee-7260-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045), but it breaks states down into three areas of focus:
* **Defend** : Fight back everywhere Republicans have passed — or might soon pursue — new gerrymanders. This requires every tool in the toolbox, from ballot initiatives to strategic legal action to voter education and mobilization. Wherever Republicans try to bend our democracy to secure power, we’ll be doing everything in our power to stop them.
* **Counter** : Just as voters have done in California and Utah, we’ll pursue assertive and responsible countermeasures in states to ensure the national congressional map reflects the true will of the people.
* **Advance** : Several states currently hang in the balance with divided government or state courts whose majorities are up for grabs in the elections ahead. We’re building a proactive electoral strategy to shore up Democratic trifectas, independent judiciaries, and legislative or gubernatorial firewalls that can prevent the next Trump-led gerrymander before it starts.

This is not a moment for tiny tweaks or small ambitions. clean_body: This is a comprehensive strategic approach to fight back against the GOP redistricting crisis | Peter, As we write this, Democrats remain poised to take back the House of Representatives this fall. That simply would not be true if our movement didn’t fight back when Donald Trump unleashed an unprecedented attempt to gerrymander states across the country. If we had not rapidly mobilized, Congress would have been locked in Republican hands for the foreseeable future. But the bad news is now that the Supreme Court has gutted voting rights protections, we are entering a new stage of this crisis — one that is shamelessly rooted in insidious racial discrimination. This poses an existential threat to American voters: denying the people the right to choose their government and enabling rampant corruption by limiting voters’ ability to hold politicians accountable. The good news is we have a rigorous, multi-front strategy to defeat Trump’s gerrymandering and protect our democracy. You can , but it breaks states down into three areas of focus: Defend : Fight back everywhere Republicans have passed — or might soon pursue — new gerrymanders. This requires every tool in the toolbox, from ballot initiatives to strategic legal action to voter education and mobilization. Wherever Republicans try to bend our democracy to secure power, we’ll be doing everything in our power to stop them. Counter : Just as voters have done in California and Utah, we’ll pursue assertive and responsible countermeasures in states to ensure the national congressional map reflects the true will of the people. Advance : Several states currently hang in the balance with divided government or state courts whose majorities are up for grabs in the elections ahead. We’re building a proactive electoral strategy to shore up Democratic trifectas, independent judiciaries, and legislative or gubernatorial firewalls that can prevent the next Trump-led gerrymander before it starts. This is not a moment for tiny tweaks or small ambitions. Defeating this onslaught of partisan and racial gerrymanders demands that we throw out outdated playbooks and work with the American people to level the playing field. subject: 🌶️ Friend, do you like green chile salsa? 🌶️

body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk846-fr-ndem-header&t=1&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
---
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. This week, we made history by winning all 33 counties in New Mexico and **officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor.** I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10451?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
---
Today, this victory feels deeply personal. It brings me back to the kitchen table conversations that shaped my values long before I began fighting for working families. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community.

One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10451?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of Governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**
[**_Pl_** _**ease, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now to help me become the next Governor. When you click this link and donate, I'll share my own green chile salsa recipe with you! >>**_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10452?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)

clean_body: | | | Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. This week, we made history by winning all 33 counties in New Mexico and officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor. I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead. | | Today, this victory feels deeply personal. It brings me back to the kitchen table conversations that shaped my values long before I began fighting for working families. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community. One of my favorite New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me. I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state. Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico. I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment. That’s the kind of Governor I will be. I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico. | | Thank you for your support, Deb | | | | |

---
Peter, Okay — we got some BIG news for you. Yesterday, Becca helped force a vote on Trump’s unauthorized war in Iran. **And guess what? We won.** The House voted 215–208 to pass a War Powers Resolution directing Trump to end U.S. military involvement in Iran unless Congress explicitly authorizes it. **That means a majority of the House — including four Republicans — voted to say: No, Mr. President, you do not get to drag us into war while Congress sits quietly in the corner.** That is exactly the kind of fight Becca came to Congress for. And it is exactly the kind of fight we need your help sustaining. [_**If you’re fired up about this win, will you consider clicking here and pitching in $5, $10, or $25 today to help keep Becca in Congress fighting with everything she got for peace, accountability, and working people?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731311/625494565/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=) Here’s the thing: Becca didn’t just show up yesterday and cast a vote. She helped lead this fight. **Back in April, she introduced a War Powers Resolution because she saw what was happening and refused to let Congress shrug its shoulders while Trump put service members in danger, blew through taxpayer dollars, and tried to normalize another unauthorized war.** **[HELP FUEL THE FIGHT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731312/625494566/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=)** That is what leadership looks like. Not a strongly worded tweet. Not a cable news soundbite. Actual strategy. Actual pressure. Actual votes. And now, because Becca and her colleagues kept pushing, the House has sent a message loud enough for the White House to hear: **You are not a king and the constitution is NOT optional.** Meanwhile, Trump’s team requested **$350 billion** in additional funding for this war. **$350 billion.** That is roughly the cost of extending Affordable Care Act tax credits for another ten years. So when Becca says this is about priorities, she means it. We can fund health care. We can lower costs. We can invest in housing, child care, climate, schools, and the communities that keep this country running. Or we can keep shoveling mountains of money into an unauthorized war that Congress never approved and the American people never asked for. **Becca knows which side she’s on. And so do we.** But here’s the part we need to be real about: when Becca takes on war, corporate greed, right-wing extremism, and the people who think Congress should be a rubber stamp, she paints a target on her back. **So we need to have hers.** _**[If you can, will you click here and make a contribution today to help us defend Becca’s seat and keep this kind of fearless leadership in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731313/625494567/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=)**_ The Senate needs to act next. This fight is not over. **But yesterday proved something important: when we organize, push, and refuse to back down, we can force Congress to move.** Becca is doing her part. Now let’s try our best to do ours! **Thank you from the bottom of our heart for always having our back.** — Team Becca

body:
We’re reaching out one more time ...
| | Peter – we fell just short of our crucial signature goal, so we wanted to reach out one more time.
---
With this race heating up, Roy needs to know if you’re in his corner. **[Please add your name right now to personally endorse Roy as we fight to flip North Carolina blue and win back the Senate for Democrats.>>](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=6&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)**
Thanks in advance for strengthening our people-powered movement.

Team Cooper
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)**
Date: Jun 2, 2026
Subject: Will you add your name, Peter?
| | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=7&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)
Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I keep hearing versions of the same thing:
🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seems unthinkable.

🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and nobody in Washington DC seems to care.**
When I hear things like this, I know it’s time to get to work. That’s why I’m in this fight. As North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator, I will put the people before power, party and politics – as I did for eight years as Governor:
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**
[_Peter, will you add your name now to personally endorse my campaign for Senate? I’m aiming to gather 25,000 signatures before the end of the day, and it would mean a lot to have you with me in this fight._](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=8&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)

Thank you,

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

subject: Chutzpah
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action
body:
|
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=4&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) Peter, it’s Elaine Luria, and Blue Amp Action said I could reach out because it’s a pivotal moment for our campaign. The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed in April. [**So, our race just became even more crucial to our battle for the House Majority. Before I get into my background and how I’m fighting back, will you split a $25 donation to flip VA-02?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=5&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) | [DONATE $25 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=6&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c)
---
_Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._
In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama.
That took some serious _chutzpah._
My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind.
That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community.
That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed.
In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms.
In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them.
In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous.
In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened.
In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them.
The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.**
Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.**
Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need.

Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win.
Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode.
There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to?

Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane.

clean_body: Plus: Why this race could be over by the Fourth of July | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com | | | | | | | | | | | | `Gregg Hull just won the GOP nomination for New Mexico governor in a real stunner — outspent 3-to-1 by Doug Turner, who had been closing fast in the final week. by riding huge support across the Albuquerque metro.`` ``Now it's Hull vs. Haaland — and she just buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout of her own.` | | 🔥 HULL TAKES THE GOP — KRYSTY WAS RIGHT! Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win. Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode. There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to? 🔵 HAALAND THUMPS BREGMAN — NOW SHE GOES UNDERGROUND Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane. Jay's words on her general election plan: she's going to make Joe Biden look like the greatest retail politician ever. And the warning Jay delivers next should keep Hull's team up at night. | | | 🎯 HULL'S PUNCHER'S CHANCE — AND THE 2006 PLAYBOOK Hull has a path. This is important: This week, it’s been reported that Donald Trump is going to drop his $1.8 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund for his criminal friends... because of you .
You spoke out, you refused to back down, and it worked. Donald Trump is not immune to public pressure. Don’t ever think your voice doesn’t matter, because it does, and this win is proof.
I know it can feel like nothing we do makes a drop of difference against an administration and a president this brazen and corrupt. Using the Justice Department to make Trump and his family untouchable, and to cover up the horrific crimes in the Epstein files. Trying to create a billion-dollar slush fund for insurrectionists using your taxpayer dollars. It would be hard to believe, if we didn’t see it with our own eyes.
But public pressure works, and that’s exactly why we keep fighting. So we’ll speak out and do everything we can to stop, delay, and blunt the harm from this administration in the short term — but what stops it permanently is losing power , and in November we can make that happen.
Flipping the House means real subpoena power, real oversight, and the ability to demand answers from an administration that has spent two years trying to make itself untouchable.
No one — not even the President of the United States — is above the law, and in November we can make sure he knows it. But we need to build up our resources to get there. Will you chip in to our campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

Fellow American,
I can't thank you enough.
I am beyond grateful for your support. It is the fuel that keeps our campaign moving.
I wake up every morning driven by a single purpose: making a real difference in your life and protecting the values we hold dear in Maine.
When I made the decision to run, I knew the attacks would be relentless. I am confident in my decision because I know I am not standing alone.
You have my back, and I have yours.
Together, we are a firewall protecting our common sense decisions. Again, thank you for standing with me. I would not be where I am today without your support.
Sincerely,
Susan Collins

There is something about May that feels uniquely American

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
### There is something about May that feels uniquely American. School years come to an end, the days stretch a little longer, and communities start spending more time outside with friends and neighbors. We also got one final snowstorm - a reminder that seasons rarely change all at once.
###
### This campaign is a lot like that.
###
### The work of building momentum doesn’t happen overnight. It happens conversation by conversation, county by county, and neighbor by neighbor. This month we traveled the district, met with voters, heard more concerns and we are building the momentum to win in November... Thank you for being here.
---
| |
### Best, Eileen.
---

| | We started May by hosing or attending**six meet and greets in four different counties**. I ended the month with three days in Highlands Ranch handing out poppies with my friend Bob Marshall and attending three Memorial Day events around Douglas County in celebrations of service and sacrifice.
Last week, **I visited with the workers currently locked out from their jobs at the Cargill meat packing facility in Fort Morgan**. Lauren Boebert has never supported the men and women in our communities who work tirelessly to package the meat raised here in our district. Thank you to Teamsters Local 455 for organizing on behalf of these meatpackers for fair wages and safe working conditions. I also heard from many about the impacts the drought and other geo-political and economic conditions are having on our beef supply.
It was great to **join with community for Douglas County Pridefest** in Parker. It was POURING rain, but that did not stop us!
This month I also continued my tour of various health centers in our district and spent some time with Brian in South Loveland **checking out the services Sunrise Community Health Center in provides**. The incredible team at Sunrise is dedicated to expanding access to quality, affordable health care. The service they provide is so necessary.
---

Speaking of service, I am honored to announce a **collaboration with Nancy Lacore and Leela Gray**. Nancy is running for Congress in SC-01 and Leela is running in FL-13. Nancy served our country in the United States Navy for 35 years and Leela in the Army for 30 years. Together, we have six stars, hence we are calling our collaboration [**Six Stars**](https://us.list-manage.com/Zvh5QmLpyJ8?e=1c5f08419c&c2id=9f711ebcee4618a2092828a4c98e410a).
I am honored to collaborate with these two incredible women. Their dedication to service and willingness to continually step up for their communities is inspiring. I hope together, we can lead our districts, and our nation, to **better opportunities for all.**

## Blanche Faces Senate Fight for AG Post
President Trump announced he will [nominate acting Attorney General Todd Blanche](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCngc5osfktXFxDl2uvRBt7AUf-QXgTjrc_Ja9w9Uij-ebnNt_QeRfXbwykeUlzpDN7YqZj5uMZ9oiBcqQTV7SEvBmfzCxBdgI6Ae1s0flrbkqrFyJJqiRd9wN0bQNNW26aBqotdv0ythYAxsaYblCklGzJjNaUTr_boIO2BuhlU7UK5FCbu6rJjGocigbIOk5H9Ugu8kaLv9KLjsqkUHq9Me-5UF-FnAo5nedZLen3rXjnhZz25B07kws5fUAi45XFRiKm4CIyCTTs4ipwFZysFXeP0WwkdjoCRorsL-EJrXg8MztDwtKOBweKXB7a7qfz3uWuLxpYAzr_2cX_OvOl5V8AAAD__3lTjJY) to permanently lead the Justice Department, elevating his former defense attorney to the nation's top law enforcement role. Blanche faces [resistance in his own party](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE9jMlDjHxgCB5uQzaYbosZuwCtjI9wzaG7_xFzhJZVUqar0_XtOTwwxpPUv7mR5yVOiq0RipnPi87UfCXcqiS5c0RPy5mJ2kwTZ1dDVYCaPIX4mXXm7EElSFdm2f0BnNGhTbXZwM3pNoLrZmF75RXW9GlAPrVxcq3QV7N0GHZgWoJe6MQrko3WzaskNangIDeQD57P5n0PijZb4yW86G5f3KtqN-ShC_RFyFHK8rqs5cgwcXL4DQo4xvKl-HR6ZipDjvSbkCF_RQo4up_WkcntzxOQ2KvUrOToZQ6oP5K0GGAwYNVSn9ccVYgyl64WGdccQvz_4V_DeVv4EAAD__9cUgQY) on the Senate Judiciary Committee, where he can lose only one Republican vote and multiple GOP members remain uncommitted, largely over the issue of the administration's controversial $1.776 billion Anti-Weaponization Fund Blanche told lawmakers that the fund was dead, but [refused to put it in writing.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp_GdET-wfwULlZa0WW13ZZosAeY1WAjmCTK21_lvsKtP-k7OufffboDMeX1D-wYZClTxtfFKILnJOdjPzLseGV8wQoJQbbIJU5W27bWba39lID4PTVVCguiRVdhMF2vW9_oxldbcNF4SIMznen0MLS2hwWNnWOajW-HWFH4vOlWe6N1Z5ubd9r2Js7OYBzc0KtGYyIp5-1_oSwbLvwuTzxvsewVh03kuJT7peyo7Ahz_Bh8NmXHv4VJKF7KjjNDjhtedS47ZRAquYa1fhwbMdcziDAqO15SzrdyIyXlfhvnfD90na3OkI4XMdPVdqrR6w7E33z5UbRnsF8BAAD__8bff-E) Trump then told reporters he didn't know if the fund was truly finished, calling it "a beautiful thing." Multiple GOP senators [filed amendments](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OhCAUhZ8GOwwioBYU29jNtlsahKveDT8GmDHz9puZTfYFtr73fDnf-botN4Me4_5pAui6pSXCVTzUCnmp-R7OaAKUCJfZjQNTD-uTXTjjijJFmVycQf9cROP0BsChb0B3w8iUFEzI5tByG1bgMA2r3EQnFe-kcM5YoSSb1LA1qF80ppjsGBu4aGXP-NjZte_ATv00EsHAYU25_U4Y6wGbf6YH5Nam0Hh91HoW0n8QPhM-X9fVxtW-LF53wuczeaxoC-HzW4gaFzBiqdlUTJHw2eMD6OrT_veyehPtAdSmuGcohbqjULRAMQTcf4MUs4k0oKuQA30z7qczFQrNNppejP00Nlm780LvsaiBCLYHg_5dvP5r7YfmPwEAAP__m26XVg) Thursday to kill the fund through legislation, with one retiring senator warning that Blanche won't survive his confirmation hearing unless the issue is fully resolved.
## Texas Passes California as Fortune 500 Capital
Texas has [overtaken California](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAUBODT4IzWM8bYDgg6sTTBbLqh9QY_bHb5sYAetm-_6r7CpF9JpVL9_tw-0XkXj18YSFebtkiteKqV8lbzI1wRA5VIDQ_cCetpfDKbAKE4KA7jtqPzz012u7ZEgoaOdD_NoEYJcuxO_UVmVhL3ZZmtVTTCsuxS2kUMZjIwzJ3TrzZQMPYAk5C3cQAx9-Zr6MkswzIzCbS7mvLtT3KxnmT9M31TvpkUOq_PWq_ChjsTKxNra-0WSnxlTKwU-aMwsYYU6cnEalK4MDp6WaV_WLgrvJ7EIzVu8HIVPU_2TTbl-ojERwBe8a-LBzfonU05OuSFm5xaZGLFzO93IT8-VOyy3q_mvHdFTUzCEdD598z6o2-_tfgfAAD__9cmjk4) as home to the most Fortune 500 companies, claiming 57 headquarters to California's 56 on this year's list. The shift was driven by companies like [Tesla, McKesson, and Oracle](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OqzAQxfGngc7IDJ8pXNyGLrfdEg32OHhlPJE9Ccnbr7KvsP1PR0f_r-t6xRBDuv3Hg4x4XhOdJZII5VXy47gnPKgkOvGGjlB2G9muoGFUelR6WB2G-F772hlPBNTVZNpp1uPQ636odwNktwuNczt3frM0gnUWHHrwnZu2fqqD-azpUQ-t1hP0zdBpmFu7dS3ZS3eZq16TC8K5-eaQZCcf3_yk3Fg-6mh2kXupun8VLBUs53k2nl_bo4REpXxMBQtZTny8K1gsxuA5p4AqcqGiPGd5JFKD1spmPpMSemFRW4gxcMKQSQm-lOyZUFRkPkqdjbufH1DGqer17cAQf-_Inxo-DfwEAAD__0NkiaA) relocating to Texas, drawn by the Lone Star State's lack of personal income tax and lighter regulation. Meanwhile, a proposed California ballot measure would impose a one-time 5% [wealth tax](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE8DmZExmJ_AwSZks-mGqMduQ6-MjeyeYeb2K_YKX1ylUr3357E-gALF7TccaNinNeJVAjJjXjm_jjPCgSXiBRs4BN5tSHZVUg1CDkLq1QGF79rXznhEhV2Nph0nOehe9rrezaRnPSu0SrmnlradrPIIwwgwaS-hrcnca3KQupVyVH2jO6mm1j67Fu3czVPVS3TEKTd_E0Xe0YdvemNubDrqYHbms1Tdr0otlVqu62p8-twUd16p5UyBmGyp1MLwEZ62ncX54iIsBPIpRwJhUwhUKEVh0ysXFE8KgVIEylhEQHijyOhEYWAsdTbuvO5GGcaql9sBFP7f4R85fBv1LwAA__-dNoli) on residents with assets over $1 billion, a move critics say is accelerating the exodus. Texas also [led the nation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0Tuu2zAQheHVUN0YIz70KFSkUXfTphRG1FBiQFMOObbi3QfOFm59gAN8-H99LV8UU8z7T7rzJOFcMl81sQiXRcrz_sh055r5op02Jjl8Ov2iUXeAHaBbNorpvdhmmwKzZtPw1PYDds6idc0xdVvLK4YBnRnRU2esMWxG1OzZmjU0cfq8YYeuRey1vTmDemj9alr2oxkHZZG3KGe5_T5jloNDep8vLjd_3ps0HSKPqswPpWel5-u6blcg-oxKz1Qk-sRKzx-X0nM6PSWlZ35xecsR815hjfvOBWIG4b9UIWafnlvMO4SzyDMzOEQ4mLY_TyrCpUIVEobEtFXIJPHMcEU5wPVKz3roIYRVc-dW8IMNYPvgYVjHAKNzw9ivvu20a8q0Pa6YUqxdryzud4rpv0q-leI16X8BAAD__9UCnNs) in population growth last year, adding more than 391,000 residents while California posted some of the steepest losses.
## Sherpa Found Alive After Week on Everest
A 52-year-old Sherpa guide was [found crawling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAURL9GM6wrIDoBwUvM5qUbWnfgquwiWMAMO3-_5f7Cpt1VXX3Ox325o_MubP_xIF3WuASq2VMplJaSnscZ8KAcqOKGlrDsxkezcOCKgWIwLBadfy-ytXol4iRa0v04gRokyKHdNVcjByuVuEkY5SCU5WpCJQa5Qm_HsXX6WgMFQw8wctkNAvjUm4foydzEbWokkHUlpu4zulB2Wv07vih1Jh6t13spZ27Ev4bPDZ9rrV14mIvi6q8kJm8bPmN22PA575ROZIfL2YWNVaIvdsRnKIxelCgXFiJbY7Qsfr83CixRNk-yzCSslyn2wEwsmYBCTrKf2qTtWZ33LquxkbAd6Pzvt_InoS_NfwIAAP__JneK5Q) toward Mount Everest's base camp after surviving about a week on the mountain without food or oxygen. His wife and daughter had already begun [funeral rituals](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuO6yAYhJ_G7hxhboaC4jTpctotrT8wxKzwRUAS5e1X3lfYcjTSjL7v6zbfKOW0Pf7TCtfiPm9414zWUOZWnuux0Yq64U0PCqC2-Lz7mTOuB6YHpuZAKX9m2QcXAQ7Rw42TYVpJJlW_OGWN1pa8NYq4gZVCQlvCPU7acFCf3LnGNFMjYxOXFyUYN6O_ixHeCms6yRBS28vle09bWxDzZ3-hXPy-9tktrR21E_86fu34lY4T4KzOUFryGR2_4oWC2oa6oBw0FFT_RBiCHrnwXKpJIQotYhSjsJLRpMnSpPriwvFOOaeqp06yx0op__62P8l6Of4TAAD__zoPe7U) when they learned he was alive. His daughter asked for photos before she could believe the news. A cleanup crew spotted Dawa Sherpa near the Khumbu Icefall, still in his summit suit with severe frostbite on his hands. He was helicoptered to a hospital in Kathmandu. [See a photo of the sherpa here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OhCAURp8GOw0CohYU29jNtlsaBi7Khh8DV828_Wa22QfY-vtyTnK-HutD--DT9qkjKHR5TXDXAIhQVixnPJKOUBPcetMWNO4mZLMyymRLZUuH1WofXqtorHIADHgDqh8nKgdBxdDsyjgtxTTz4dmPghk3az5SY5yRrBdgXePVm0YlHXpKRya6gVM29ebJezAznyciKFiPuXTf2SfcwYVXvqB0JscmqB3xqIR_ELYQttz33eUTq7eQU_AJ3i_Clnyizbm02l6Q8CxA2AIXFKhI2FJ3KIduo6_Vp62N-UzY_s1NUfa4fQi-ypEIukXtw68e_9XsUuwnAAD__zxGgxA). More than 1,000 people [scaled Everest](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhiAYha8GN8wrIOrA0MXt69rRILwqLT9GUPPdfWNvodtJTnLOk-frNb208y6unzqgKkuaIt7ZYyl4TOU4wx51wBzx1qu2qMtmfDITAyYpSArtZLXz70lUVi2IDHmFqul6kK0A0Vab6s1sNGDX9rPgQ2MZX7Q0jQQQVg68r5x61kBC2wB0TNQtB9Y3ZuYNmoEPPRGA1pV01N_JxbLh4t_pwqM2KVRebaXsmfAPwkbCxvu-azM_wPnpCRufSNi4ns4iDS5nF1d6I_7QkM5YKF54YC50SWe0VHt3IZ11Rmp02Akbq0PZ_Xbeuyw7ImAN2vm_7_IvYZdivwEAAP__qr-AiQ) this May in its busiest season ever. ## Screwworm Confirmed in South Texas
[Federal officials confirmed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu5CAMhp8m6RgZEiAUFNtMN9tuGRkwEyRyEaC5vP0qKc4LnO63LH329_97zA9MOW3Pv7iSbZ-4zxu9a6bWqJzxvZccqi9XWtPW6IN1mQUIxUAxkHPAlL_z2AfrIBjek-V6AiX1IMZ-sSCi59FpI4HrCYegwZtoJk0wiIG7PtkTBgok5yBguAkIJuIAODnvlOLdCBRS28utLXTdj_m7v6jc_L722S6tHbUb_nTi3ok7HqfAuTqH0pLP1In7jwKLmerCCFvanuzAgjU1Yh5by8QuPBMUvSSvTDBKcic9OHTjJCQFHI1WfbHheKecU1W6G-G5YsrXN-13Hb6s-B8AAP__-SGG2w) the first New World screwworm case in Texas since 1966. The flesh-eating parasite was found in a 3-week-old calf in La Pryor, Zavala County, about 50 miles from the Mexican border. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins [announced the detection on Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGOpTAMhk8DnZ-cEAKvoNiGbrbdEhnHGSIF8pRkh5nbr2BXe4HpftvyZ33yr7fljUIMx_tP2mWqnz4th5wlSq2Sr3imHF3hfKc9HFU-qWyLRm0BLWC_OArxazGtm1Z0T9XKpIYRbT902rTb1ItVzj3NiJ55xJ6Ze4W6UzJyr_u1DdMFQ4u9Uqixe2h0T08d0rjyaq1qDIoLNeVH3eS-7-NX-pD84LS3cdpqfZWm-9HoudHzeZ6P0xNdw0bPlGvgKI2eL69Gz6VSvcobBP-ah5xwm8J_VeB0-JB3cRAOKOl33eDvDlP0cGOADgdenGSKkLwPHCgWyFJe6XCNnvU4ABoyPCgFNBgHBtnAqPEJqx6sdyPz4Nc2T-51hhhDsUNj8H2nEG-9-r2nfEz6TwAAAP__Urqikw) after the USDA's National Veterinary Services Laboratories in Ames, Iowa, confirmed the sample. Texas State Veterinarian Bud Dinges swiftly established a 12-mile quarantine zone, barring any warm-blooded animal from leaving without inspection. Officials stressed the food supply faces no risk. Screwworm larvae burrow into open wounds on living animals but [do not infest processed meat](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SpDAMhU9jMlOyAIMDB5uQ9aYbUgLLjWsNdBlP0337KZipucBkT39P-vTvNtwoxLDe_9LCNr_8Nqx87JFz5nTKY0vR7VO61BLWzC_a5wEBtQQtoRkchfge6sLZEZxRBVvVdqCbtsK6mK0iNKy8MxqNd21TtZXWTJ0D06jJmyLY0ww0NEoBQlUiOOOpAurGadRaiRrYhbylMs987ffxvT05ldO2FNHOOT92Uf0R2Avsj-Mo_z8_-CwK7CnlMEUW2J9cAvs9Uz7Dy0h-J1c-5EUqf1DlV0Pix5YyOznRfo6hNpLAK4dayVF1layN7mSneJJExOBr7rhxRbLucYQYw65bUcN9oRCvg_Pv3vy0-BkAAP__oJ2RnA). Rollins said no other U.S. cases have been detected, and the infected calf is expected to recover. To contain the spread, the USDA has been [dropping millions of sterile flies](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAQgJ8GO8wwKmpB8Td2-7dXGoRxJYewEXbZffuLFvcC133JJPPNN1-3-aadd-H-X--k8nuNc6CSPOVMx4klHt4mc1y0u5DprdM2I6DkIDl0s9XOf-a2smoBO4qKlOgHkF3fYFttCrW04yhQklxNK5AsdLbpx0GgHkYzVE6dy0BCJwQgNDWCHVfdgB4Ws0gpWAtkXY5HnTe6_Kv_xBcdtYl75dWW8yOx5h_DieFUSqm_3zqcQ4bTWcNweiaruQ4hPoOhxB8xJbd44oEKvxL5byN3YSWTXQzcBZ7iM2_8sjKcqkPZR3HeuyR71sJ9185fZ-S_Pe-l8CcAAP__d5WHJQ) into the region--the same technique used to eradicate screwworm from the U.S. in the 1970s. Texas leads the nation in cattle production, and industry leaders have been sounding alarms about the parasite's northward march through Mexico for more than a year.

## Anthony Murder Trial Gets Underway
Opening statements began Thursday in the [Collin County murder trial](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAUhE-DO6zHAxOnoNiGLttuaT0MjtFiE2E2xLdfOVf4u08aaT7N_HlMD4op7s_ftAVTP0ue9tCOFGoN5cKWS_LHXL60xb2GDx3rhICag-YwTJ5iOifVeePA30UXjLiNoIebRNWtBkkJT8qHAZxD4cZB-1FKAjFKJaXoornKQMMgBCDIHsHfF5JAo5ud1oIpCD7WXPq6hq9_SWd-h9LPeeuSWWt9HUz-YmgZ2tZav7vZL-2KGdprD0Ob8kyJof1LZQspc9rrmveTb_-KD4XXEinxpcRjztzTyQVDq0CKEYCh7YrxrxZTioe-MQXPjWL6-uvPXnsb_B8AAP__Th6BRQ) of Karmelo Anthony, 19, charged with fatally stabbing 17-year-old Austin Metcalf at a Frisco ISD track meet in April 2025. Prosecutor Bill Wirskye told jurors the killing was a premeditated "sneak, surprise attack"--arguing Anthony provoked the confrontation rather than tried to avoid it. Both were 17-year-old athletes from rival schools at the time. Anthony faces a sentencing range of 5 to 99 years or life in prison if convicted of murder.
